candidates.priorities_note: Her campaign website has no list of issues and no stances on our 6 issues. It has a home page and an About page.

priorities.heading: Angie believes in Medicare for All.
priorities.quote: Medicare for All that covers every person in America — free at the point of service, with no premiums, no deductibles, no copays, and no surprise bills.

priorities.heading: Angie believes in Universal Child Care & Pre-K.
priorities.quote: Universal, high-quality child care and pre-kindergarten for every family, regardless of income, capping costs so no family pays more than a small share of their income.

priorities.heading: Angie believes in quality Public Education.
priorities.quote: Tuition-free public college and trade school, and canceling student debt.

cost-of-living.heading: Angie will fight for the Working Families Guarantee
cost-of-living.quote: A universal jobs program with inflation-adjusted wages

housing.heading: Angie will fight for the Working Families Guarantee
housing.quote: A National Rent Freeze and Moratorium on Evictions

health-care.heading: Angie believes in Medicare for All.
health-care.quote: Medicare for All that covers every person in America — free at the point of service, with no premiums, no deductibles, no copays, and no surprise bills.

immigration.heading: Angie believes in supporting human dignity, ending mass incarceration and deportation.
immigration.quote: A humane immigration system, including a swift path to citizenship for Dreamers and undocumented residents, and a moratorium on deportations pending a full audit of enforcement practices.

foreign-policy.heading: Angie believes in a foreign policy rooted in diplomacy, human rights, and restraint.
foreign-policy.quote: End to the war in Iran and rebalance the federal budget toward investments in everyday people here at home

climate-energy.heading: Angie believes in climate action that matches the scale of the crisis.
climate-energy.quote: A bold, union-built transition to renewable energy, creating millions of good-paying, union jobs in wind, solar, and grid modernization, prioritizing the frontline communities that have borne the brunt of pollution for generations.
